articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, July 15, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 before the U.S. financial markets open. The company will host a conference call and simultaneous webcast at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma to announce second quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026

articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, July 17, 2026 — The board of directors of Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) has approved the payment of a dividend for the third quarter of 2026 of $0.235 per Class A ordinary share.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma declares third quarter 2026 dividend

articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, July 22, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it has acquired a portion of Neurimmune’s royalty interest in AstraZeneca’s cliramitug for up to $425 million, including $125 million upfront.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma acquires royalty interest in AstraZeneca’s cliramitug for up to $425 million from Neurimmune
